docs.summary:
The purpose of this study is to measure the change in high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP), a marker of inflammation in the body, with clazakizumab compared with placebo in adults who have elevated hsCRP and at increased risk for cardiovascular event.

docs.title: Evaluation of the Effect of Time of Administration on the Activity on First Line of Pembrolizumab in Association With Carboplatin-pemetrexed in Metastatic Non-squamous Lung Cancer. A Randomised Multicenter Phase III Trial
docs.summary: IMMUNOTIME is a French multicenter randomised phase III trial in patients with metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer starting first-line treatment with pembrolizumab, carboplatin and pemetrexed. Patients receive the standard regimen and are randomised to start their pembrolizumab infusions either in the morning (08:00-12:00) or in the afternoon (13:00-17:00). The trial aims to determine whether morning administration improves survival at one year. A total of 242 patients will be included in 33 centres.

docs.summary: The purpose of this clinical study is to learn about the safety and effects of berobenatide (PF-08653944) for the treatment of knee osteoarthritis in adults with overweight or obesity with and without type 2 diabetes. The study will last 52 weeks and compare the effects of berobenatide compared to placebo on knee pain, physical function, and body weight. Study activities will include blood tests, knee pain assessment, physical function questionnaires and body measurements.
